# B-Line Fishing Charters

> B-Line Fishing Charters runs private sportfishing, spearfishing, Avalon shuttle, and coastal cruise trips in Southern California aboard Solstice, a 37-foot EdgeWater center console, departing from Huntington Harbour in Huntington Beach, California. Every charter is private for a group of up to six guests and is planned around the season, weather, experience level, and what the group wants to do.

## Key facts

- Business name: B-Line Fishing Charters
- Port of origin: Huntington Harbour, Huntington Beach, California, USA
- Service area: All of Southern California — including Catalina Island, Avalon, San Clemente Island, the offshore banks, Newport Beach, Laguna Beach, Long Beach, and Orange County coastal waters
- Boat: "Solstice," a 37' EdgeWater with triple outboards, a full tower, and open fishing space bow to stern
- Capacity: Private trips for up to 6 guests (up to 6 divers for spearfishing)
- Phone: 714-620-5933
- Email: bradysmith9@icloud.com
- Website: https://bradys-charters-hb.netlify.app
- Booking: Request a date through the website form or by phone. No payment is taken until availability is confirmed.
- Audience: Beginners, families, experienced anglers, freedivers, and groups wanting a private island day are all welcome.

## Trips

Fishing charters

- Catalina Island — 3/4 day or full day, up to 6 guests. Targets: yellowtail, white seabass, calico bass, bonito.
- San Clemente Island — up to 10 hours, up to 6 guests. Long-range island fishing, subject to weather, access, and Navy closures.
- Offshore Banks — up to 12 hours, up to 6 guests. Targets: bluefin tuna, yellowfin tuna, dorado, yellowtail, kelp-paddy fish.

Spearfishing expeditions

- Kelp & Reef — island structure, kelp edges, and rocky reef for yellowtail, calico bass, and sheephead.
- Bluewater — open-water hunting around banks and temperature breaks.
- Custom Support — private route planning and drop-and-pickup positioning for experienced dive groups.
- Divers bring personal gear and must hold all required licenses.

Boat Days, Avalon shuttle, and coastal cruises

- Avalon Private Round Trip, Avalon Drop-Off, and Avalon Pickup.
- Private Island Cruise and Private Island Bar Hop at Catalina.
- Newport Dinner Cruise, Laguna Coves Cruise, and Custom Coastal Cruise.

Pricing is one flat rate for the whole private boat and is quoted per trip based on route, hours, and group size. Fishing licenses, gratuity, and optional fish processing are not included.

## Target species

Bluefin tuna, yellowfin tuna, yellowtail, dorado (mahi-mahi), white seabass, calico bass, bonito, halibut, barracuda, rockfish, and sheephead — depending on season and conditions.

## Frequently asked questions

- Where do trips depart from? Huntington Harbour, Huntington Beach, California, aboard the boat Solstice.
- How much does a charter cost? Pricing is quoted per trip based on route, hours, and group size. Call 714-620-5933 or use the booking form.
- How many people can come? Up to 6 guests — the whole boat is private to your group.
- Do you offer spearfishing? Yes — kelp & reef, bluewater, and custom dive support trips.
- Do you run Avalon shuttles? Yes — private round trips, one-way drop-offs, and pickups, plus Catalina boat days and coastal cruises.
- Are beginners and families welcome? Yes.
- How do I book? Use the website booking form or call 714-620-5933. No payment until B-Line confirms your date.
